S01.prompt_en:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide vertical shot of a sunny park path with a wooden fence and flower bed in the background. The scene features three plush mascots: a yellow chick in a blue hoodie (Jacky), a black-and-white malamute puppy (Soda), and a small calico kitten (Mimi) sitting on the grass to the right. Natural real-time movement at normal human speed; no slow motion or time stretching.

0.0–0.4s: The scene is static. Jacky stands on the left, Soda in the center facing the flower bed, and Mimi sits on the grass. All characters have closed mouths and neutral expressions.

0.4–3.29s: <d>[English] Hey, Jacky! Look! Who’s that?</d> Soda initiates the action by turning his head toward the right (toward Mimi) and lifting one front paw slightly off the ground. His mouth moves naturally to match the dialogue. Jacky stands still, listening with a gentle expression, his wings tucked at his sides. Mimi remains seated on the grass, her body still, only her head tilting slightly in curiosity while her tail tip sways gently.

3.29–3.64s: A brief pause where all characters hold their positions. Soda’s paw remains lifted as he watches Mimi. Jacky shifts his weight slightly forward, preparing to speak.

3.64–5.99s: <d>[English] I think it’s a little kitty! Let’s say hello!</d> Jacky leans slightly toward Soda and extends one wing to gesture toward the kitten, then retracts it. His mouth moves clearly for the dialogue. Soda lowers his paw back to the ground and watches Jacky. Mimi continues to sit on the grass, her amber eyes fixed on the two friends, her expression curious and alert.

5.99–6.38s: The characters settle into a stable pose. Jacky stands upright, Soda faces the flower bed again, and Mimi remains seated. The camera holds the wide framing, capturing the full bodies of all three mascots against the park background.

camera: Fixed wide shot, slightly below eye level, showing the path, fence, and flower bed. All three characters are fully visible in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Soft ambient park sounds, gentle breeze, subtle rustling of grass, and clear dialogue audio.

non_diegetic_music: Light, cheerful acoustic guitar and soft piano, 100 BPM, no vocals.

RULES: No extra people, no reflections of other people, no text overlays, no watermarks, no cuts, no held or looped tails.

audio_turns.emotion: Curious and excited, head tilted toward the flower bed, one forepaw lifted

audio_turns.text: I think it’s a little kitty! Let’s say hello!
audio_turns.translation: 我想那是一只小猫咪！我们去打个招呼吧！
audio_turns.emotion: Warm and encouraging, leaning slightly toward Soda, one wing gesturing forward

0.0–0.4s: All three characters are in a static, attentive pose. Soda stands on four paws, facing slightly toward Mimi. Jacky stands quietly behind Soda's left shoulder, mouth closed, observing. Mimi sits on the grass to the right, ears forward, looking at Soda.
0.4–3.256s: Soda begins to speak with a friendly, shy expression. His mouth moves naturally to match the dialogue. As he speaks, his front paws gently draw together in a polite gesture, and his fluffy tail begins a slow, rhythmic wag. Jacky remains perfectly still with a closed beak. Mimi listens attentively, her amber eyes focused on Soda, her ears perked forward.
3.256–3.606s: A brief 0.35-second pause. Soda finishes his line and holds his gaze, front paws together. Mimi's tail tip gives a small, curious flick.
3.606–7.948s: Mimi begins to speak with a bright, happy expression. Her mouth moves to match the dialogue, starting with a small meow sound before her greeting. As she speaks, her head lifts slightly, and her tail tip flicks gently in time with her excitement. Soda listens, his tail wag slowing but continuing softly. Jacky remains a silent observer in the background.
7.948–8.333s: Mimi finishes her line with a warm smile. All three characters settle into a calm, friendly posture. The scene ends with a stable, balanced composition of the three friends.
overall_soundscape: Soft park ambience with distant birdsong and a gentle breeze rustling leaves. Subtle fabric rustling sounds from the plush characters' movements. Clear, high-quality voice acting for Soda and Mimi.
non_diegetic_music: None.
RULES: No extra people, no reflections of other people, no text overlays, no watermarks, no cuts, no fast spins, no blur on hands or tails, no changes to character identity or outfits.

7.53–8.0s: Mimi settles back into her seated position on the grass. Both characters hold the final pose briefly as the clip ends.
